prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was telling a coworker about that quick stop in Xi'an, just chatting about what there even is to see there.
Around the same time, another friend was raving about a stay they had in Nanjing, like the whole city vibe felt super chill.
And I still remember that work trip where the route was Beijing to Shanghai—everyone kept comparing train times like it was a sport.
For Xi'an, Zhou Jun had tickets sorted for the Bell Tower already—there were 4 of us going in total.
That Bell Tower visit was on 2025-03-20, and we went in the afternoon slot, which actually worked out nicely.
In Nanjing, Lucas Martinez stayed at Hanting Hotel Xuanwu, checking in on 2025-03-10.
He said it was for 4 nights, and separately my teammate Isabella Jackson took train G1 on 2025-04-12 in Second Class—she kept the ticket screenshot forever.
